description: This PHP source file defines the DataObjects_Banners class, representing the 'banners' table in the database for the Revive Adserver project. It includes properties for banner attributes, methods for CRUD operations, duplication, cache rebuilding, and audit trail management.

classes.name: DataObjects_Banners
classes.description: Represents the 'banners' table with properties for banner attributes and methods for managing banners, including deletion, duplication, cache management, and audit trail integration.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a banner object based on a key-value pair.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the banner and associated banner files, with cascade options.

methods.name: deleteBannerFile
methods.description: Deletes the banner file based on storage type and filename.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates the banner, optionally associating it with a new campaign.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts the banner into the database and adds default ad zone and placement zones.

methods.name: _rebuildCache
methods.description: Rebuilds the HTML cache for the banner if htmltemplate is set.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the banner and refreshes the HTML cache.

methods.name: _imageDuplicate
methods.description: Wrapper for phpAds_ImageDuplicate to duplicate banner images.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Indicates that audit trail is enabled for this object.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID, which is the banner ID.

methods.name: getOwningAccountIds
methods.description: Returns account IDs owning audit trail entries, derived from the campaign.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an array of audit information specific to campaign banners.
